hero.title: Your community. Your courses. Your rules.
hero.sub: Posts, courses, events and discussions under your own name and design. Hosted in Germany, no ad tracking. The lean, fair alternative to bloated community suites.
hero.refrain: Your place, where the sun breaks through.

problem.title: A real community should belong to you – not to someone else's network.
problem.lead: Circle, Skool and Mighty Networks are powerful – but for small communities often expensive and heavier than you need. Self-hosted forums like Discourse save money but cost you server ops and headaches. Pukalani is the lean middle path: a complete community platform you start without hassle, fully under your brand – with a transparent, predictable price.

rows.gain: Fair, predictable price. Free to start.
Hosted in Germany, no ad tracking.
